_comment: ThePerch openclaw cron job template. Copy into ~/.openclaw/cron/jobs.json (merging with any existing jobs your install already has) and adjust paths/timezone. The 9 jobs below are the ones SETUP-FOR-AGENTS.md Step 13 enumerates. All use the lightContext + exec + zai/glm-5 + NO_REPLY pattern so the cron agent runs the script silently on success. Each `payload.message` invokes a wrapper script via `bash`; ship those wrappers under your openclaw workspace (e.g. ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/run_<name>.sh) — they should `set -a && source ~/.openclaw/secrets/perch.env && set +a && python3 ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/health-integrations/<script>.py`.

jobs.name: oura-ingest
jobs.description: Pull Oura sleep + readiness; primary sleep source.

payload.message:
Run exactly this command once and wait for it to complete:

bash $HOME/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/run_oura_ingest.sh

Rules:
- Do not change the command.
- If it succeeds with no output, reply exactly NO_REPLY.
- If it produces output, reply with a brief summary.
- If it fails, do not mask or summarize.

jobs.name: 8sleep-ingest
jobs.description: Pull 8sleep sessions; fallback sleep source. Reverse-engineered, may break.

payload.message:
Run exactly this command once and wait for it to complete:

bash $HOME/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/run_eight_sleep_ingest.sh

Rules: same NO_REPLY pattern as oura-ingest.
